summary.ru: Знакомство с данными: одна область у северного полюса эклиптики, 15 визитов SPHEREx за 17 месяцев.
summary.en: A first look at the data: one field near the north ecliptic pole, 15 SPHEREx visits over 17 months.

processing.resampling: bilinear interpolation of the L2 IMAGE extension onto the common grid using the frame's own TAN-SIP WCS (forward A/B and inverse AP/BP polynomials)
processing.flags: a flag category is set when a source pixel carrying it contributes more than 25 % of the bilinear weight
processing.masking: pixels with NONFUNC, MISSING_DATA, SUR_ERROR, OVERFLOW, HOT, COLD or NONLINEAR flags are set to no data
processing.display: per-frame median background subtracted in the browser; one shared asinh stretch for all frames of a field
processing.units: MJy/sr (L2 calibrated surface brightness, zodiacal light not subtracted)
processing.storage: float16 (relative precision about 0.05 %), values beyond +/-65000 clipped and flagged

format.name: NTF1
format.layout: magic 'NTF1', uint16 width, uint16 height, uint32 reserved (little endian); float16[width*height] surface brightness in MJy/sr, row 0 = north, NaN = no data; uint8[width*height] flag categories; whole payload gzip-compressed

source: SPHEREx Level 2 frames from the IRSA AWS Open Data copy (s3://nasa-irsa-spherex)
